open_item_bindings.effect_on_this_scenario: Design v1.15 section 22.6, "20 (5a) GREEN has pre-window" left the LEGACY premise as [OPEN-EMBED-05] and design 15.6 blocked the runnable premise and its dependent cells. The owner answer makes the premise reachable: lifecycle 1 opens and closes on ordinary bars before 2000-01-01T00:00:00Z, so at the window start no position is eligible for TEST-FUND-1. Because those fills are outside the observation window they contribute no in-window fill, cash, fee or exit facts. The pre-window fills DO consume the GREEN cost record (Design v1.15 section 14, "taker 0.001 on its notional"; Design v1.15 section 22.6, "20 (5a) GREEN has pre-window"); the pre-window fill prices/quantities are unenumerated, so the equity node carries BLOCKED-OPEN-EMBED-05 (Design v1.15 section 14, "taker 0.001 on its notional"; Design v1.15 section 17, "a formula (fee_i = abs"; Design v1.15 section 22.6, "20 (5a) GREEN has pre-window").
